definitions.explanation: To move the body rhythmically, usually to music. Used for both traditional and modern dance styles.

examples.japanese: {盆踊|ぼんおど}りで{踊|おど}りました。
examples.english: I danced at the Bon festival dance.

examples.japanese: {音楽|おんがく}に{合|あ}わせて{踊|おど}る。
examples.notes: に{合|あ}わせて = in time with

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{上手|じょうず}に{踊|おど}れる。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pattern: Xが{踊|おど}る (X dances). Can also take を for specific dances: ワルツを{踊|おど}る (dance a waltz).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {踊|おど}っている = 'is dancing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{音楽|おんがく}に{合|あ}わせて{踊|おど}る (dance to music)
・ワルツを{踊|おど}る (dance a waltz)
・{踊|おど}りを{踊|おど}る (perform a dance)
・{一緒|いっしょ}に{踊|おど}る (dance together)

RELATED NOUN: {踊|おど}り (dance, dancing)
